settings.text: How often should I use Sulfur Spot Treatment?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · This formula is ultra gentle, so you c…
settings.text: This formula is ultra gentle, so you can use it as often as needed. Most people use it overnight, but it also works great as a daytime treatment on problem areas.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Will Sulfur Spot Treatment stain or bl…
settings.text: Will Sulfur Spot Treatment stain or bleach my pillowcase?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Nope! This product won’t stain or blea…
settings.text: Nope! This product won’t stain or bleach your clothes, towels, or bedding. It’s made with sulfur, which doesn’t have bleaching properties. Most spot treatments that stain contain benzoyl peroxide.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Does Sulfur Spot Treatment smell like …
settings.text: Does Sulfur Spot Treatment smell like sulfur?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our R+D team worked hard to minimize t…
settings.text: Our R+D team worked hard to minimize the classic sulfur scent. However, as a natural compound, you may experience a light scent.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Can I layer Sulfur Spot Treatment with…
settings.text: Can I layer Sulfur Spot Treatment with other acne treatments?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes! Sulfur plays well with others. Yo…
settings.text: Yes! Sulfur plays well with others. You can pair it with ingredients like salicylic acid, benzoyl peroxide, or retinoids to boost results—just keep an eye on how your skin reacts.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Is it safe for sensitive skin?
settings.text: Is it safe for sensitive skin?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes — it’s the skin banu was built for…
settings.text: Yes — it’s the skin banu was built for. Unlike benzoyl peroxide or high-dose acids that burn and dry, sulfur draws out the oil and bacteria behind a breakout without wrecking your barrier. Non-irritating, alcohol-free, non-drying, and tested on facial skin across all six Fitzpatrick tones.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · How long until I see results?
settings.text: How long until I see results?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · It’s clinically proven to visibly redu…
settings.text: It’s clinically proven to visibly reduce the appearance of breakouts overnight. Depending on the size and severity of your breakout, you may need to use it more frequently.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Why is the Sulfur Spot Treatment bette…
settings.text: Why is the Sulfur Spot Treatment better than a pimple patch?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · A patch covers the spot; it doesn’t tr…
settings.text: A patch covers the spot; it doesn’t treat it. It can absorb surface fluid, but it can’t reach the oil and bacteria building under the skin — which is most of a breakout. Sulfur does that work overnight, without drying or bleaching. Sulfur Spot Treatment is an FDA-regulated OTC acne treatment, not a cosmetic. Which means it’s actually clinically proven to treat and heal acne, not just cover it up.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Can I use this as a full-face treatmen…
settings.text: Can I use this as a full-face treatment?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · You can use it on broader areas, overn…
settings.text: You can use it on broader areas, overnight or as a 20-minute treatment mask. Just be sure to apply a thick layer wherever you’re breaking out.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Is it safe during pregnancy?
Paragraphe · Yes. It’s formulated without retinoid …
settings.text: Yes. It’s formulated without retinoid or benzoyl peroxide, and its active is 10% pharmaceutical-grade sulfur — used safely for over a century. As always, it’s smart to run any new product by your doctor.
